An '''individual''' was a [[Security guard/Legends|guard]] with the [[Alderaan Guard/Legends|Alderaan Guard]] assigned to protect [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was involved in a shootout when [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Robonino/Legends|Robonino]] and [[Chata Hyoki/Legends|Chata Hyoki]] attempted to attack Senator Organa. Along with members of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], this individual and his fellow guardsmen were able to take the bounty hunters into custody though not before the Senator was severely wounded when his speeder crashed.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Alderaanian guard was voiced by comedian and voice actor [[Phil LaMarr]].<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />
